title: A Theory of Speciation in Generative Diffusion Models on Compact Riemannian Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2608.23798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speciation in generative diffusion models denotes the emergence of distinct stable branches during denoising, through which initially undifferentiated trajectories progressively commit to different data classes. In this work we develop an intrinsic theory of speciation for diffusion models supported on compact Riemannian manifolds: the aim is to go beyond existing theoretical descriptions, which usually identify speciation with a symmetric pitchfork bifurcation and assume to work in a large-dimensional space. We characterize speciation by bifurcations of the critical points of the evolving probability density. A spectral heat-kernel representation makes explicit the role of the manifold geometry, while Poincar\'e-Hopf and Morse theory impose global constraints on the number and type of score equilibria and reveal topologically-imposed geometrical modes. For mixtures of heat kernels, we prove that generic speciation events have a one-dime

translated_title: 紧致黎曼流形上生成扩散模型中的物种形成理论
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23798v1 公告类型：新 摘要：生成扩散模型中的物种形成指的是在去噪过程中出现不同的稳定分支，初始未分化的轨迹逐渐承诺到不同的数据类别。在这项工作中，我们为支撑在紧致黎曼流形上的扩散模型开发了一个内在的物种形成理论：目的是超越现有的理论描述，这些描述通常将物种形成等同于对称的叉形分岔，并假设在高维空间中工作。我们通过演化概率密度的临界点的分岔来刻画物种形成。谱热核表示明确展示了流形几何的作用，而庞加莱-霍普夫和莫尔斯理论对分数平衡点的数量和类型施加全局约束，并揭示了拓扑强加的几何模式。对于热核混合，我们证明了典型的物种形成事件具有一维性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个基于黎曼流形几何和拓扑约束的扩散模型物种形成理论，通过临界点分岔和热核表示，证明了典型物种形成事件的一维性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a theory of speciation in diffusion models on compact Riemannian manifolds, characterized by bifurcations of critical points and constrained by topology, proving that generic speciation events are one-dimensional.
